ITEM 1 | Triangular wedge of flatbread-like base with pale golden-cream crust, scattered dark brown spotted char marks and browned blisters across the top, slight orange-tinged sheen near edge, firm edges, sits at upper right of plate, roughly 8 cm long and 5 cm wide with a thickness of about 1.5 cm | 45

ITEM 2 | Irregular folded piece of brown-grey meat with a smooth, slightly glossy seared surface, darker brown crust edges, fibrous layered texture visible at the cut side, dense and moist-looking, sits directly beside the wedge at right edge of plate, roughly 6 cm by 4 cm and about 2 cm thick | 60

ITEM 3 | Small scattered yellow-orange crumbs and bits on the table surface beside the plate, slightly granular, dry, about 1 cm each | 2

ITEM 4 | Small olive-green flecks of herb or vegetable fragments lying on the table near the plate bottom edge, finely shredded, dry-looking, about 1 to 2 cm across | 1
